complexityHeuristic: Prefer a deterministic or model-assisted workflow when steps are known and the model need not own the control loop.
Else use one bounded agent with a constrained tool set, budgets, and exit conditions.
Add ordered stages, parallelism, specialist routing, or handoffs only when they create demonstrable value.
Do not select multi-agent topologies because they appear advanced.

costAccuracySpeed.note: Autonomy without budgets/gates usually worsens Cost volatility and Security even when Speed looks better on the happy path.

workloads.title: Knowledge / RAG Assistant
workloads.intent: Grounded answers from a corpus or curated knowledge base — with explicit bars before authority.
workloads.defaultShape: Bounded assistant: retrieve/load knowledge → assemble context with provenance → generate → epistemic gate → authoritative answer; optional low-risk side effects via Tool Gateway.

dominantTrades.tension: Deeper retrieval and stronger models buy grounded accuracy; thin context and fast small models buy speed/cost but raise miss and hallucination risk.
dominantTrades.defaultChoice: Accuracy/Reliability and provenance over raw Speed; bound Cost with just-in-time retrieval.

dominantTrades.tension: Provenance + refusal paths improve Definition of Done but add validators and sometimes human review.
Live API/SQL grounding can beat stale RAG for operational facts at round-trip latency cost.
dominantTrades.defaultChoice: API/SQL for live facts; RAG for narrative docs

dominantTrades.tension: Stuffing large top-k or broad SQL tools worsens injection surface, cost, and mid-context miss rates.
Non-authoritative until grounding passes slows replies; skipping the gate spends Reliability/Security.

failureModes: Treating RAG hits as authoritative without citation or coverage checks
Using the LLM as a database for facts that belong in API/SQL
Context stuffing top-k everything
Adding write tools without product need
No refusal path
workloads.whenNotThis: Account actuation / customer case resolution → customer-chatbot. Multi-system business process with durable DoD → workflow-agent. IDE/repo assist → internal-copilot.

workloads.title: Customer Service Chatbot
workloads.intent: Help a customer resolve an enquiry through conversation using approved knowledge and live systems of record, with escalation when needed.
workloads.defaultShape: Conversational agent with identity gate, FAQ/policy RAG + live account tools via Tool Gateway, epistemic checks, HITL on consequential writes, escalation with context.

dominantTrades.tension: Live API reads + policy RAG + validators buy accurate outcomes; a fast stuffed-FAQ model is cheaper/faster and more often wrong.
dominantTrades.defaultChoice: Correct outcome / clean handoff over raw Speed

dominantTrades.tension: HITL/policy gates on refunds buy Security; they spend Autonomy and Speed.
Identity and Tool Gateway checks add latency; skipping them expands blast radius.
Escalation and dual knowledge paths raise cost; transcript-only success looks cheap until disputes.
Unbounded conversational loops without budgets explode Cost and Context.

failureModes: Model invents account facts instead of calling APIs
Write tools without Tool Gateway
Escalation drops context
FAQ RAG overrides live policy without resolution rules
Treating chat transcript as proof of completion
workloads.whenNotThis: Pure grounded Q&A → knowledge-assistant. Internal employee assist → internal-copilot. Back-office multi-step process → workflow-agent.

workloads.title: Internal Copilot
workloads.intent: Assistive help over repos, docs, or ops context for employees — suggest by default, tightly gate writes.
workloads.defaultShape: Assistive agent with just-in-time context (open files/repo slice/RAG/tools), suggest-only or confirm-before-write, session memory by default, environment-separated identities.

dominantTrades.tension: Frontier models + large repo slices buy quality; smaller models + tight slices reverse the triangle.
Suggest-only or confirm-before-write buys Security; spends Autonomy and perceived Speed.
Org-wide retrieval or prod credentials expands exfil/injection impact.
Tests/scanners before apply improve Reliability; silent apply is faster and fails later.
Opaque durable memory looks efficient until drift, leaks, and rework dominate.

failureModes: Silent writes without confirmation
Whole-org retrieval without tenancy
Durable memory storing secrets or stale decisions
One super-copilot identity with prod credentials
Treating vendor defaults as an ACC
workloads.whenNotThis: External customer dialogue with account tools → customer-chatbot. Grounded public/corp Q&A without IDE context → knowledge-assistant. Durable multi-system workflow → workflow-agent.

workloads.title: Workflow Automation Agent
workloads.intent: Multi-step business process with tool writes and a verifiable Definition of Done — agent judgment inside a governed spine.
workloads.defaultShape: Deterministic or staged spine with model-assisted steps, Tool Gateway, checkpoints, idempotent writes, post-write verification, budgets, optional HITL at write boundaries.

dominantTrades.tension: Stronger models and evaluator loops on judgment stages buy Accuracy; serial gates spend Speed and Cost.
dominantTrades.defaultChoice: Reliability/Ops over Autonomy and raw Speed; spend Accuracy budget only where judgment is required

dominantTrades.tension: Deterministic spine + gates + checkpoints buy resumability; add serial latency vs one unbounded loop.
Idempotent writes and verification reads cost extra; skipping them saves spend until duplicates arrive.
Tool Gateway + least privilege + optional HITL constrain Autonomy at writes.
Unbounded retries/evaluator loops without budgets blow Cost and Sustainability.

failureModes: Agent owns entire process with no deterministic spine
Done claimed in natural language without reading back system state
Non-idempotent writes + retries → duplicates
No checkpointing
Missing budgets
workloads.whenNotThis: Conversational customer resolution → customer-chatbot. Grounded Q&A without multi-system DoD → knowledge-assistant. Interactive IDE/doc assist → internal-copilot.
